text:
You need someone who can support customers on demand, improve their analytics setup, and turn web and performance marketing data into actionable guidance.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a Marketing attribution analysis project for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit in Looker Studio. That helped reallocate 18% of ad budget and brought customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter.

I can help maintain and refine dashboards, troubleshoot data issues, and suggest practical improvements to existing reporting setups. I’d be comfortable working with Google Analytics, Data Studio/Looker Studio, and customer-specific dashboard tweaks.

What are the most common customer setup issues you want this role to handle first?
